name: The Ehime Bank, Ltd.
summary: The Ehime Bank, Ltd. provides banking products and financial services in Japan. It operates in two segments, Banking and Lease. The Banking business segment includes banking services, such as deposits, loans, and domestic and foreign exchange. The Leasing business segment involves leasing operations. It is also involved in computer-related, credit card, guarantee, and support services. The Ehime Bank, Ltd. was founded in 1915 and is headquartered in Matsuyama, Japan.
